notes: Customers file: code structure (12 digits, level, parent, leaf status), identity checks, telephones, required area / branch / class, locked fields once transactions exist, departments and salesmen, credit limits, delete rules, balances and activity panel (APP_RULES3_AR).

rules.where: (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or CODE in (select CUSTOMER_CODE from AR_CUST_PASSWORD where PASSWORD_NUMBER = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))

key_expr.CUSTOMER.CODE: app_rules3_ar.need_num('يجب إدخال رقم العميل', 'Enter the customer code')

row_rules.CUSTOMER: if app_rules3_ar.is_form('CUSTOMER') then app_rules3_ar.customer_row(inserting, :new.code, :old.code, :new.customer_level, :new.customer_status, :new.customer_type, :new.customer_id, :new.company_id, :new.company_registry_id, :new.telephone1, :new.telephone2, :new.telephone3, :new.fax, :new.day_no, :new.credit_limit, :new.stopflag, :new.stopdate, :new.stopreason, :new.mainarea_id, :old.mainarea_id, :new.subarea_id, :old.subarea_id, :new.cust_class, :new.account_no, :new.disc_account, :new.cost_code1, :new.cost_code2, :new.currency_code, :old.currency_code, :new.open_date, :old.open_date, :old.stopdate); end if;

after_save.name: العميل الرئيسي والأقسام وحدود الائتمان وحساب العميل

warnings.name: قسم العميل
warnings.plsql: return app_rules3_ar.msg('لابد من ادخال قسم للعميل (بعد الحفظ في جدول الأقسام و المندوبين)', 'You Should Insert Dept. for Customer (after saving, in the departments and salesmen grid)');

CUSTOMER.MAINAREA_ID.lov: select id || ' - ' || name_a d, id r from ar_mainarea order by 2

CUSTOMER.SUBAREA_ID.lov: select main_id || '/' || id || ' - ' || name_a d, id r from ar_subarea order by main_id, id

CUSTOMER.CUST_CLASS.lov: select serial || ' - ' || class_name d, serial r from ar_cust_class where nvl(dscnt_stop_flag, 0) = 0 order by 2

CUSTOMER.ACCOUNT_NO.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 order by 2

CUSTOMER.DISC_ACCOUNT.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 order by 2

CUSTOMER.COST_CODE1.lov: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where nvl(cost_status, 0) = 1 order by 2

info.name: AREA
info.sql: select max(decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(m.name_e, m.name_a), m.name_a) || ' / ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a)) from ar_mainarea m, ar_subarea s where m.id = to_number(:PAGE_MAINAREA_ID) and s.main_id (+) = m.id and s.id (+) = to_number(:PAGE_SUBAREA_ID)

info.name: CLASS
info.sql: select max(decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(class_name_e, class_name), class_name)) from ar_cust_class where serial = to_number(:PAGE_CUST_CLASS)

info.name: ACC
info.sql: select max(decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(a.account_name_e, a.account_name), a.account_name)) || ' / ' || max(decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(d.account_name_e, d.account_name), d.account_name)) from dual left join ac_master a on a.account_number = to_number(:PAGE_ACCOUNT_NO) left join ac_master d on d.account_number = to_number(:PAGE_DISC_ACCOUNT)
